correctness.rationale: For every \(n\ge3\), acyclic flow decomposition yields precisely the path indicators (i,j), and their exact squared distance is an interval symmetric difference plus two start/end penalties. Exhaustive endpoint multiplicity classes with 2, 3 or 4 distinct values give the \(O(n)\)-term closed histogram; evaluating and differentiating verifies total mass and rational mean. The largest exponent and equality source are classified including exceptional n=3. \(\operatorname{Beta}(2,3)\) is obtained by a rigorous coupling to four independent uniform endpoints and an \(O(n^{-1})\) variation bound. The actual embedded standard-library checker reconstructed directed edges and exactly matched all 25,704 unordered pairs for n=3,…,16. Finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: This gives a complete natural Euclidean invariant of an infinite family of special polytopes: a finite \(O(n)\)-term generating polynomial for all distinct vertex pair distances, exact mean, complete diameter graph and a sharp beta limit with rate. Counting metric pairs is not implied by already-known Catalan volume or affine combinatorial type. The infinite metric classification, not the classical beta identity by itself, is the substantive contribution.
